name: Quatre Camins – Cota 427 cross, Vilalba dels Arcs
story: At the Quatre Camins crossroads (Cota 427), south of Vilalba, the Catalan Carlist volunteers of the Tercio de Requetés de Nuestra Señora de Montserrat held a Nationalist position facing the Republican 31st Mixed Brigade on Punta Targa (Cota 481), only about 250 m away. On 19 August 1938 the requetés attacked towards Punta Targa and lost 58 killed and 174 wounded, according to the unit's figures; Republican losses are not recorded. This small site is a reminder that Catalans fought on both sides of the battle.
see: A memorial cross at the crossroads, with the facing hills of Punta Targa in view.
plan: Roadside site south of Vilalba dels Arcs; free; combine with the Barrancs trenches and the Montserrat crypt of the same unit.
